title: 第 30章 遭咧
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
大这个词是相对的。

    如果鱼是这个身形自然是大，但如果钓上来的是个人，那便不大了。

    最为晦气的便是钓上来的人身穿的居然是镇妖司服饰。

    虽然只是基础的衙役服，但只要和镇妖司搭上关系的，总不会是什么好事。

    楚星尘神识扫过面前被自己钓上来的人。

    炼气七层修为，而且居然还活着，没有彻底凉凉。

    楚星尘原本打算要是这人死了，就全当没看见重新踢回江里去。

    如今人还没死，便自然不能这么做。

    无奈下，楚星尘还是向前走了两步，目光看向命大的镇妖司成员。

    是一位样貌还算年轻的男子，长得还行，不过同楚星尘还是差了不少。

    可能入水时间还不算长，脸色惨白但还未浮肿。

    双眸紧闭，但脖子上有暗红色的能量顺着脉络开始流转。

    楚星尘微微皱眉，这是中毒了？！

    谨慎起见，楚星尘腰间取出一枚银针，用灵气操控刺入那脉络之中。

    暗红色流转之后，这一枚测毒银针依旧没有反应。

    不是毒。

    楚星尘微微放心，随后神识直接扫描面前的男子的脉络，发现那一股暗红色其实是一种狂躁的的能量。

    此刻还在顺着脉络冲击着面前男子的身体。

    要是不施加援手，恐怕活不了多久。

    微微叹气，楚星尘拿起几枚银针刺入面前男子的基础脉络大穴，封住男子心脉，保证他起码不会因为这股能量冲击心脏死去。

    至于其他位置的脉络会不会被这能量撑爆，就不是楚星尘能保证得了。

    施针完毕，楚星尘微操法力，将面前的男子直接放在自己钓鱼躺着的躺椅上。

    全程不触碰面前的年轻男子。

    拿起躺椅的一角，连着躺椅带着少年郎朝不远处的渝州城走去。

    渝州城门口自是有守卫看守。
content_en:
The word big is relative.

If the fish is this size, it will naturally be big, but if it is a human being caught, it will not be big.

The most unlucky thing is that the person caught is wearing the clothes of the Demon Suppressor.

Although it is just a basic government service, as long as it is related to the Demon Suppression Division, it will not be a good thing.

Chu Xingchen's consciousness swept over the person he had caught in front of him.

He is at the seventh level of Qi refining, and he is actually still alive, not completely desolate.

Chu Xingchen originally planned to kick this man back into the river as if he hadn't seen him if he died.

Nowadays, people are not dead, so naturally they cannot do this.

In desperation, Chu Xingchen still took two steps forward and looked at the fateful member of the Demon Suppression Department.

He is a relatively young-looking man. He is not bad looking, but he is still quite different from Chu Xingchen.

Maybe he hasn't been in the water for a long time, and his face is pale but not swollen yet.

His eyes were closed tightly, but dark red energy began to flow along the veins on his neck.

Chu Xingchen frowned slightly, was he poisoned?!

To be cautious, Chu Xingchen took out a silver needle from his waist and used his spiritual energy to control it and pierce it into the veins.

After the dark red color circulated, the poison-detecting silver needle still showed no reaction.

Not poison.

Chu Xingchen was slightly relieved, and then his consciousness directly scanned the veins of the man in front of him, and found that the dark red energy was actually a kind of manic energy.

At this moment, it is still impacting the body of the man in front of me along the veins.

If we don't lend a helping hand, I'm afraid I won't survive for long.

Sighing slightly, Chu Xingchen picked up a few silver needles and pierced the man's basic meridian points, sealing the man's heart veins to ensure that at least he would not die due to the impact of this energy on his heart.

As for whether the veins in other locations would be exploded by this energy, Chu Xingchen couldn't guarantee it.

After the acupuncture was completed, Chu Xingchen used his magic power slightly to place the man in front of him directly on the recliner where he was fishing.

Do not touch the young man in front of you during the entire process.

He picked up a corner of the recliner and led the young man towards Yuzhou City not far away with the recliner attached.

There are guards guarding the gate of Yuzhou City.
